label: Is visible in GUI
summary: Whether the rite is shown in the game's interface.
details: Returns yes or no. In the faith window, vanilla shows a rite hostility section, the Convert button and a button to look for a character of the faith only when this is yes (the two buttons also need the rite not to be historical-only). The game does not say what makes a rite visible or not.

label: Rite as scope
summary: Turns the rite into a script scope that GUI code can hand to script.
details: The faith window and the conversion window add it under the name 'rite' and then compute the script value pam_knows_rite_level, which is defined as knows_rite_level(scope:rite); going by its name it is how well the player knows the rite, shown as a percentage. The result is a scope for script, not a value to show.
